title: Principal Product Manager
jobDescription:
Principal Product Manager
- Agentic Investigation & Reliability Experiences Sumo Logic is hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead how engineers and operators investigate incidents, understand reliability risk, and act on their operational and security telemetry. The observability category was built around collecting telemetry and giving people tools to navigate it: dashboards, queries, monitors, traces, and alerts. Customer expectations are now shifting. Teams don't just want more dashboards; they want help getting from a signal to a resolution, understanding what's broken, why, what's impacted, and what to do next. As AI agents move into production operations, this role owns how Sumo Logic brings intelligent, agent-assisted investigation and reliability workflows to customers, grounded in evidence, context, and enterprise governance. This is a senior, high-ownership role. It requires genuine observability domain background. You should have lived in this space and understand how monitoring, troubleshooting, and reliability actually work, combined with the ambition to define a new category of experience on top of it. What You Will Own The current data experiences. Log Search, Live Tail, query and query optimization, Metrics Search, Tracing, Dashboards, and the data-experience UI. This is a live, revenue-generating product with real customers, and keeping it strong is part of the job. You own its health, roadmap, and competitiveness today while steering it toward an AI-native future, focusing new investment where it strengthens investigation, speed, and value for both new and power users. The reliability and alerting surface. Monitors, Alerts, SLOs, Scheduled Searches, and the reliability workflows around them. You will own alerting accuracy, noise reduction, and operational health signals both as capabilities customers depend on today and as the foundation for more automated, agent-assisted detection and investigation. The agentic investigation experience. You will define how a user moves from a search, a monitor, a dashboard, or an alert to likely cause faster, with supporting evidence. This means productizing investigation workflows that reason across logs, metrics, traces, monitors, dashboards, and related context, and evolving them from reactive troubleshooting toward more proactive detection over time. What You Will Be Doing Set the multi-quarter vision for Sumo Logic's investigation and reliability experiences, and turn it into a roadmap engineering can execute against. Own the roadmap, health, and competitiveness of the current data and reliability product surfaces. Define how search, metrics, tracing, dashboards, monitors, alerts, and SLOs evolve from human-navigated tools into more intuitive, AI-assisted experiences. Productize investigation workflows that reason across telemetry and related operational context, and surface findings customers can act on. Own alerting accuracy, noise reduction, and operational health signals. Shape how skills, tools, and agents are built on top of the data surfaces, and ensure they respect enterprise controls such as RBAC, audit, cost limits, and approvals. Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, performance, and reliability at enterprise scale. Translate strategy into clear PRDs, proposals, user stories, acceptance criteria, and phased rollout plans. Use telemetry to understand how customers search, investigate, and configure alerts, and where they hit friction, latency, false positives, or cost. Create leadership-facing proposals that frame tradeoffs across customer demand, governance, performance, cost, and long-term architecture. What You Bring 8+ years of product management experience with real observability or monitoring domain background. You have owned products in observability, monitoring, incident response, APM, or a closely adjacent operational-telemetry space. This is a hard requirement. Deep, first-hand understanding of the observability surface area including logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, monitors, alerts, and SLOs, and of how engineers and operators actually investigate incidents and decide what to trust. Proven ability to run a live, at-scale product, owning the roadmap, health, and competitiveness of shipping surfaces while driving a larger transformation. A track record of owning broad, technically deep surfaces and setting direction that other teams build on. Familiarity with how AI and agents are changing data interaction, including natural-language investigation, tools, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop action, or the ability to ramp quickly. Strong technical instincts around query engines, time-series and trace data, and alerting systems, plus the judgment to know where an AI-assisted experience should replace a manual flow and where depth must stay. Strong analytical skills and comfort using telemetry, dashboards, SQL, and usage data to understand adoption, friction, reliability, and cost. Excellent communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write clear proposals, decision docs, PRDs, and acceptance criteria. High ownership and drive to make progress across a large, ambiguous, fast-moving surface. Must-Have Qualities Runs today, builds tomorrow. Keeps a live product healthy and competitive while reinventing it, and knows what to sustain and what to rebuild. Deep observability judgment. Understands search, metrics, tracing, and alerting well enough to make hard architecture and tradeoff calls with engineering. Operator empathy. Knows what makes an alert trustworthy, an investigation fast, and a recommendation credible enough to act on. Governance-minded. Treats RBAC, audit, cost, and approvals as part of the product. Sets direction. Defines a vision for a broad area and rallies teams around it. Analytical. Uses data to prioritize, validate, and refine decisions. High drive and ownership. Pushes through ambiguity across a large surface and drives execution to conclusion. Tradeoff thinker. Frames options and recommendations clearly for leadership. About Us Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness-combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com. Sumo Logic Privacy Policy . Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection. #LI-Hybrid

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Distributed Systems & Agentic AI
jobDescription:
Senior Software Engineer
- Distributed Systems & Agentic AI Location: Bangalore or Noida About the Role The proliferation of machine log data gives organizations unprecedented real-time visibility into their infrastructure and operations. Capturing that value means solving two hard problems at once: building backend systems that can reliably ingest, manage, and process petabytes of heterogeneous, high-volume data, and building the intelligence that reasons over that data to deliver real-time insight. This role sits at the intersection of both. Agent orchestration at our scale is a highly complex problem, involving reliability challenges that come with long-running multi-agent tasks. Similarly scaling an agent’s capabilities to solve a diverse range of tasks requires careful context engineering. It's a rare opportunity to own a production distributed system end-to-end while shaping how LLM-powered agents operate over real-world data at scale. You'll join a small, high-impact, cross-geo team and operate with a strong bias for action: defining scope, setting milestones, and shipping incremental, well-tested improvements that directly enhance the customer experience. What You'll Do Design, implement, and optimize agentic AI platform-including our agent harness, proprietary tools that work over big data, orchestration layer for multi-agent long-running tasks & integrations to third party tools. Write robust, reusable, testable & maintainable code with AI assistance. Ensure the reliability, performance, and observability of deployed agents through rigorous evaluation, testing, monitoring and continuous improvement. Collaborate cross-functionally with product, data, and infrastructure teams to deliver end-to-end, AI-powered insights. Required Qualifications BTech, MTech, or equivalent in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related discipline. 4-6 years of industry experience with a proven track record of ownership and delivery. Hunger for learning and stepping out of your comfort zone. This role is for people who are great at distributed systems, and want to pivot to working on building AI agents. Strong communication skills and a passion for shaping emerging AI paradigms. Demonstrated experience building backend services that handle data at large scale. Solid grasp of the performance characteristics of commonly used data structures (maps, lists, trees, etc.) and the fundamentals of scalable system design. Desired Qualifications Proficiency in Python and working knowledge of LLM core concepts, prompt design, and agentic design patterns. Prior experience building and deploying AI agents or LLM applications
- as side projects or in production. Experience using Sumo Logic or other observability products for reliability and security. About Us Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. title: Senior Manager, Engineering
jobDescription:
Senior Manager, Engineering
- Application Security Want to lead a global team responsible for the most important product features
- availability, reliability & security? Sumo’s SRE program focuses on continual data-driven evolution and improvement of the reliability, security, and efficiency of our global scale technological presence. We are looking for a great leader with a passion for site reliability, continuous technology improvement, and reducing the operational workload of our own engineers
- as well as our customers who leverage our products for their own monitoring and reliability. Responsibilities App Security Program: Establish and evolve strategies and processes for the product and engineering organization to meet security, privacy, and compliance objectives Guide leadership and teams in the risk-based prioritization of compliance, privacy, and security efforts, and maintain respective backlogs and roadmaps Coordinate with team leads, managers, and individual contributors to ensure initiatives are prioritized based on risks and rewards, stay on track by identifying and removing blockers, and get completed Define OKRs and build and deliver program metrics and communications to provide updates to stakeholders Coordinate and support application security initiatives (such as, regular threat modeling and the mitigation of dependency vulnerabilities) across the product and engineering organization Help product teams develop secure applications for the Sumo Logic platform. Integrate and implement solutions improving Sumo Logic’s security posture. Lead security reviews and penetration tests at design and implementation stages. Partner with the Security Operations Center (SOC) and Compliance team on our security and compliance posture, vulnerability management, and threat modeling of our tech stack. Educate product teams on secure development best practices and Quality Engineering teams on continuous improvement of security testing. Reliability Program : Drive the program that maintains excellent uptime numbers for our services. Manage error budgets and associated policies for key product SLOs. Promote blameless post-mortem culture combined with developer operational accountability. Continuously reduce operational workload for engineers by means of infrastructure improvements and automation. Collaborate to lead the reliability programs with SRE leaders across geo. Team Leadership : Lead and grow a global team of SREs adept at building extremely high-volume, fault-tolerant, efficient, and scalable backend systems. Technical Vision : Partner with our technical leadership team to review choices on an ongoing basis, in anticipation of increased scale and ever-evolving technology to meet the demands of growing business. Leverage technical skills to successfully analyze and improve the efficiency, scalability, and reliability of our backend systems. Required Qualifications and Skills B.S. in Computer Sciences or related discipline (M.S., or Ph.D. is a plus). Minimum 8+ years of industry experience with a proven track record of ownership, delivery, and operational excellence. Minimum 3+ years in a management role. Experience being responsible for key SLOs of a cloud-based Saa S: availability, uptime, performance, and security. Experience in multi-threaded programming and distributed systems. Object-oriented programming experience, for example in Java, Scala, Ruby, or C++. Experience with high volumes of data using the latest technologies such as Kafka, Kubernetes and Docker. Agile software development experience (test-driven development, iterative and incremental development). Experience in big data and/or 24x7 commercial service is highly desirable. Hands-on experience with public cloud Infrastructure-as-a-service and Platform-as-a-service offerings
- Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, etc. Good to have: Functional knowledge of global information security and privacy regulations (such as, GDPR, CCPA, and FISMA), industry standards (such as, ISO/IEC 27001, PCI DSS, and SOC2), and best practices (such as, OWASP projects, threat modeling methodologies, risk and privacy impact assessments) Experience with cloud technology environments and contemporary software engineering stacks Ability to influence across all levels of an organization, strong written and verbal communication and organizational skills, and demonstrated success in cross-functional collaboration with internal and external stakeholders Professional certifications (such as, CIPM, CISM, and CISSP) About Us Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness-combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com. Sumo Logic Privacy Policy .
